messages:
sophia: kicking off FF toggle for release/2026.03.21 — plan is gradual ramp from 0% -> 50% over 30m, then evaluate telemetry. tagging @raj for routing pin decision.
raj: ack. tracking window 22:00-23:00 UTC, change window noted in release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-21
deploy-bot: /deploy start release/2026.03.21 canary -> initiated. Canary cohort: 2% global traffic. job id: dpl-8231.
mike: quick note — model v2.1 has slightly different tokenization config, recommend pinning v2.0 for legacy routes during ramp.
sophia: good catch. proposal: pin legacy route (route=client-legacy) -> model:v2.0, ramp main route to v2.1. keep autoswitch disabled until post-rollout.
raj: +1 to pin. add a soft-fallback rule to route to v2.0 if latency > 500ms for 2m.
jen: telemetry hooks are live; will post 5m snapshots to #deploy-metrics. I set up the quick eval set (prompt: "invoice summary short") to watch regressions.
oncall-bot: ALERT scheduled: rate-limit bump threshold set to 60qps as safety; will auto-disable FF if error-rate > 0.8% for 3m.
sophia: executing flag operation now: ```
PATCH /feature-flags/toggles/llm-release-2026-03-21
{
  "action": "ramp",
  "steps": [ {"pct": 2, "duration_m": 10}, {"pct": 10, "duration_m": 10}, {"pct": 50, "duration_m": 10} ],
  "pin_overrides": {"client-legacy": "model:v2.0"},
  "fallback": {"latency_ms": 500, "window_s": 120, "route_to": "model:v2.0"}
}
```
raj: saw the PATCH, looks good. add a short note to the release: "FF uses latency fallback; legacy clients pinned to v2.0".
mike: monitoring: latency p50/p95 tracked, also token_efficiency metric. If token_efficiency drops > 7% vs baseline, we stop ramp.
jen: first 10m snapshot: no regression for correctness checks, error-rate 0.03%, p95 latency +20ms. posting graphs in #deploy-metrics :chart_with_upwards_trend:
deploy-bot: canary complete -> advanced to 10% as planned. dpl-8231 -> dpl-8231.step2.
sophia: keep an eye on fallback triggers. if we need emergency drain, use /deploy abort dpl-8231 and toggle llm-release-2026-03-21 -> disable.
raj: decision checkpoint at 22:30 UTC. if all green we proceed to 50% and then hold for 30m before full release.
oncall-bot: Reminder: quiet window ends 23:00 UTC. Ops contact: @mike oncall.
mike: received. will escalate to SRE if error-rate crosses 0.5%.
sophia: final note — I've updated the release notes with the pin and rollback playbook, and added a short blurb for CS: "If customers report hallucinations, roll back to v2.0 via FF pin and open ticket with research." :thumbsup:
raj: thanks everyone, standby for the 22:30 checkpoint.
